title: Offline play: map selection
description: The map selection screen of the online lobby is back in the offline setup form: a Map row, the Choose map sheet with the layout cards and the large board picture (answered by the wasm engine), Random, table-size handling and the loading, error and empty states. Shots 1 to 7 are the real app with the real engine; shots 8 to 10 use the in-memory launcher to force the data states.

shots.heading: Setup form with a Map row
shots.caption: A new Map row sits between your faction and the nickname. Untouched it says Recommended layout: the game then takes the layout the engine recommends for the table size, exactly as before the picker came back.

shots.heading: Choose map, recommended layout selected
shots.caption: The same sheet as the online lobby: a strip of cards (picture, name, system count, badges, Recommended) and the large board picture with a badge per seat. Layouts and pictures come from the wasm engine, not a server.

shots.heading: Another layout picked
shots.caption: A pick applies to the form at once and updates the picture. The picture is an example: seats, factions and the open tiles are drawn when the game starts (it says so under the picture). Another example redraws it.

shots.heading: Random map
shots.caption: Random is always offered: a seeded random galaxy, as in the lobby.

shots.heading: Form after Done
shots.caption: The Map row names the choice. Changing the player count forgets a layout made for another size.

shots.heading: Setup form with a Map row on a phone

shots.heading: The started game
shots.caption: A game started with a picked layout: the choice is stored in the save (setup.map, checked by the capture) so resume, export and import replay the same board.

notes.title: Picture is an example
notes.text: The game's seed is drawn at Start, so the picture cannot be the exact board; layout, hyperlanes and seat count match, filler tiles and factions are drawn at the start.
